import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
/**
 * 充值购买指令
 * 选择套餐 → 生成支付二维码 → 轮询支付状态 → 超时5分钟取消
 *
 * 指令格式：/充值购买 <套餐ID>
 */
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import PayQrCode from '@src/img/views/PayQrCode';
import { cancelBackendSponsorPayment, getBackendNormalPaymentSettlement, getBackendSponsorPayment } from '@src/api/bot/sponsor-payment';
import { getPayData } from '@src/response-apps/recharge/pay/app';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { renderCachedImage } from '@src/utils/imageRender';
import type { GuiButton } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, logger, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';
/** 轮询间隔（毫秒） */
const POLL_INTERVAL_MS = 10 * 1000;

/** 超时时间（毫秒） */
const TIMEOUT_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000;

const buildRechargeSuccessContent = (payResult?: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof getBackendNormalPaymentSettlement>>) => {
  const successMd = Format.createMarkdown();

  successMd.addText('✅ 充值成功！');
  successMd.addNewline();
  successMd.addNewline();

  if (!payResult) {
    successMd.addText('订单已由系统处理完成，请优先查看邮箱、背包或权益状态。');

    return successMd;
  }

  const packageMilk = payResult.packageRewards?.spiritMilk ?? 0;
  const bonusMilk = payResult.bonusSpiritMilk;
  const totalMilk = packageMilk + bonusMilk;
  const hasPackageRewards = Boolean(
    payResult.packageRewards &&
    (payResult.packageRewards.spiritMilk > 0 ||
      payResult.packageRewards.spiritStone > 0 ||
      payResult.packageRewards.spiritCrystal > 0 ||
      payResult.packageRewards.items.length > 0 ||
      payResult.packageRewards.equipments.length > 0 ||
      payResult.packageRewards.skills.length > 0)
  );
  const hasDetail =
    totalMilk > 0 ||
    hasPackageRewards ||
    Boolean(payResult.vipUpgrade) ||
    payResult.newcomerDayGranted !== null ||
    payResult.monthCardExtended ||
    payResult.seclusionPassActivated;

  if (!hasDetail) {
    successMd.addText('订单已由系统处理完成，请优先查看邮箱、背包或权益状态。');

    return successMd;
  }

  if (totalMilk > 0) {
    successMd.addText(`获得道晶：${totalMilk}`);

    if (bonusMilk > 0) {
      successMd.addText(`（赠送 ${packageMilk} + 双倍奖励 ${bonusMilk}）`);
    }

    successMd.addNewline();
  }

  if (payResult.vipUpgrade) {
    successMd.addText(`🎉 VIP升级：${payResult.vipUpgrade.oldLevel} → ${payResult.vipUpgrade.newLevel}`);
    successMd.addNewline();
  }

  if (payResult.newcomerDayGranted) {
    successMd.addText(`🎁 新人返利第${payResult.newcomerDayGranted}天奖励已发放`);
    successMd.addNewline();
  }

  if (payResult.monthCardExtended) {
    successMd.addText('📅 月卡已激活/续期');
    successMd.addNewline();
  }

  if (payResult.seclusionPassActivated) {
    successMd.addText('🧘 闭关卡已激活/续期');
    successMd.addNewline();
  }

  if (payResult.packageRewards) {
    const pr = payResult.packageRewards;

    if (pr.spiritStone > 0) {
      successMd.addText(`💎 灵石 +${pr.spiritStone}`);
      successMd.addNewline();
    }

    if (pr.spiritCrystal > 0) {
      successMd.addText(`💠 灵晶 +${pr.spiritCrystal}`);
      successMd.addNewline();
    }

    if (pr.items.length > 0) {
      successMd.addText(`📦 物品 ×${pr.items.length}种`);
      successMd.addNewline();
    }

    if (pr.skills.length > 0) {
      successMd.addText(`📖 功法 ×${pr.skills.length}种`);
      successMd.addNewline();
    }
  }

  return successMd;
};

export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;

  try {
    const result = await getPayData(e.MessageText, isPrivate, String(e.UserId), createBackendRequestContext(e));

    switch (result.code) {
      case 'PRIVATE_ONLY':
        {
          void message.send(
            FormatGui({
              isPrivate,
              bid,
              title: '充值购买',
              content: Format.createMarkdown().addText('⚠️ 充值购买仅支持私聊操作')
            })
          );
        }

        return;

      case 'NO_MATCH_LIST_EMPTY':
        {
          void message.send(
            FormatGui({
              isPrivate,
              bid,
              title: '充值购买',
              content: Format.createMarkdown().addText('暂无可购买的充值套餐')
            })
          );
        }

        return;

      case 'NO_MATCH_LIST': {
        const md = Format.createMarkdown();

        md.addText('请选择充值套餐：');
        md.addNewline();
        md.addNewline();
        md.addText('首充双倍: 仅普通充值生效，且只对有双倍档位的套餐显示标记。');
        md.addNewline();
        md.addText('⚠️⚠️⚠️限时活动临时套餐请使用 /活动充值；普通充值不会触发限时活动规则。');
        md.addNewline();
        md.addNewline();

        const footer: GuiButton[] = [];

        md.addNewline();

        for (const pkg of result.packages) {
          const rewardText = pkg.grantSpiritMilk > 0 ? `，赠送${pkg.grantSpiritMilk}道晶` : '';
          const doubleText = pkg.isAvailableDouble ? '，首充双倍' : pkg.isClaimedDouble ? '' : '';

          md.addText(`${pkg.id}、${pkg.name}（${pkg.yuan}元${rewardText}${doubleText}）`);
          md.addNewline();
          footer.push({ label: `${pkg.yuan}元`, command: `/充值购买 ${pkg.id}` });
        }

        void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '充值购买', content: md, footer }));

        return;
      }

      case 'ORDER_FAILED':
        {
          void message.send(
            FormatGui({
              isPrivate,
              bid,
              title: '充值购买',
              content: Format.createMarkdown().addText(`❌ ${result.error}`)
            })
          );
        }

        return;

      case 'ORDER_CREATED': {
        const { uid, orderNo, qrCodeBuffer, packageName, yuan } = result;

        // 将二维码 Buffer 转为 base64 data URL
        const qrCodeDataUrl = `data:image/png;base64,${qrCodeBuffer.toString('base64')}`;

        // 渲染支付卡片组件
        const payImg = await renderCachedImage(PayQrCode, { qrCodeDataUrl, packageName, yuan, orderNo, theme: 'default' }, 'panel:recharge:pay');

        if (!payImg || typeof payImg === 'boolean') {
          void message.send(
            FormatGui({
              isPrivate,
              bid,
              title: '充值购买',
              content: Format.createMarkdown().addText('⚠️ 支付页面渲染失败，请稍后重试')
            })
          );

          return;
        }

        const payFormat = Format.create();

        payFormat.addImage(payImg);
        void message.send({ format: payFormat });

        // 启动轮询检查支付状态
        let pollCount = 0;
        const maxPolls = Math.ceil(TIMEOUT_MS / POLL_INTERVAL_MS);
        const processing = false;

        const pollTimer = setInterval(() => {
          pollCount++;

          void (async () => {
            if (processing) {
              return;
            }

            try {
              const status = (await getBackendSponsorPayment(String(e.UserId), uid, orderNo)).status;

              if (status === 'SUCCESS') {
                clearInterval(pollTimer);
                const receipt = await getBackendNormalPaymentSettlement(String(e.UserId), uid, orderNo);

                void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '充值成功', content: buildRechargeSuccessContent(receipt) }));

                return;
              }

              if (status !== 'PENDING' && status !== 'PAID') {
                clearInterval(pollTimer);

                return;
              }

              if (pollCount >= maxPolls) {
                clearInterval(pollTimer);

                await cancelBackendSponsorPayment(String(e.UserId), uid, orderNo, createBackendRequestContext(e));

                void message.send(
                  FormatGui({
                    isPrivate,
                    bid,
                    title: '充值购买',
                    content: Format.createMarkdown().addText('⏰ 支付超时（5分钟），订单已取消。\n如已支付请联系客服处理。')
                  })
                );
              }
            } catch (err) {
              logger.error(`[Pay] 轮询支付状态异常: orderNo=${orderNo}`, err);
            }
          })();
        }, POLL_INTERVAL_MS);
      }
    }
  } catch (err) {
    logger.error('[Pay] 充值购买异常', err);

    void message.send(
      FormatGui({
        isPrivate,
        bid,
        title: '充值购买',
        content: Format.createMarkdown().addText('⚠️ 充值购买异常，请稍后重试')
      })
    );
  }
});
